# Disclaimer

## Everything here was generated by AI

The seven books, their contracts and their briefs, and most of the code in this
repository, were produced by AI language models from outlines written for the
purpose. No human wrote or edited the prose, and no clinician read it before it was
published.

## These books are not medical advice

The seven books in this repository are educational material. They are not a substitute
for medical training, for certification, for the supervision of a qualified
professional, for the protocol of the institution you work in, or for the law of the
country where you practise.

Nothing here is a diagnosis, a prescription or a treatment plan for any individual
patient. If you have a patient in front of you, follow your training, your protocol
and your clinical judgement, and consult a qualified colleague.

## Not reviewed by a clinician

The texts were written with the help of AI language models, from outlines and
contracts written for the purpose. They have not been reviewed, validated or approved
by a physician, a surgeon, a nurse or any other health professional, and they have not
been checked against any national or international guideline.

Treat every statement as a starting point for your own verification, not as a source.
No author, contributor or distributor of this repository accepts liability for any
consequence of using it.

## Numbers are illustrations, not values

The medical books give no dose of any drug, no route of administration and no dosing
frequency, by deliberate design. Where a number appears — a percentage, a temperature,
a time window, a threshold — it is there to make a principle concrete. Confirm it
against the current guideline or protocol that governs your practice before you rely
on it.

## Scope of practice

The books separate what a lay first aider, a trained first responder and a hospital
team may each do. Procedures belonging to definitive care are described so that a
responder recognises when they are needed, never as first-aid measures. Reading about
a procedure is not training in it, and this repository confers no authorisation to
perform anything.

## Work in progress

*Emergency Wound and Trauma Care* is incomplete: some appendices are still missing.
The finished books may contain errors of fact, emphasis or omission, and the
incomplete one certainly does.
